text:
Tess: Mystery marmalade alert  who left an open jar dated 3/2 in the fridge? It's gooey everywhere. Can I toss or is it claimed?
Rohan: not mine. also low on croissants 22f can someone swing by the bakery at 10:30?
Bea: I'd take a plain croissant and one vegan muffin if available. Also need almond milk for the cold brew.
Logan: I can do a quick run if you want. ETA 10:20.
supply-bot: Fridge snapshot: Almond milk: 0.5L, Oat milk: 1L, Marmalade (open): unlabeled (date 2025-03-02), Croissant box: 0, Coffee beans: 8% left. Refill suggestion: Almond milk + croissants.
Tess: thanks supply-bot. If no one claims marmalade by 10:15 I'll compost it. Could we start labeling jams? :grimacing:
Rohan: compost away. Please grab extra butter if the bakery has them.
Bea: adding vegan muffin + almond milk to the tally. I'll Venmo $4 to @logan-venmo.
Logan: great. If someone remote wants to chip in, drop $$ in the silver tin or Venmo.
HRBot: Reimbursement reminder: treats under $25 may be covered from team snack fund. Put purchase note in #operations-expenses with receipt.
Tess: pinging ops to see if snack fund can cover today since we're low on supplies. @supply-bot is ops the right channel?
supply-bot: Yes. Ops note: if team snack fund approves, mark expense with tag "snack-fund" and upload receipt to https://ops.redwood.infer/snacks.
Rohan: left $6 in tin.
Bea: sent $4 to Logan. Also FYI I labeled my lunch this morning but someone took it anyway - please use names :sob:
Logan: back with croissants, muffin, almond milk, and extra butter. Left on front desk in a paper bag. Also I rinsed the marmalade jar and tossed the remnants. New jars go on shelf labeled "condiments".
Tess: you're a champion. :trophy: Quick note for everyone  label open jars with name+date, store condiments on shelf 2, and if you open the espresso machine please run a cleaning cycle.
Rohan: cheers. Croissant for me was perfect.
Bea: muffin is delicious. Thank you Logan!
Logan: no prob. Leaving receipt on whiteboard for Ops.
Tess: final: almond milk restocked, marmalade gone, and espresso warmed up. Please remember the labels so we don't re-live the sticky shelf saga.
